_why: Phase-5e Task 3: the 26 execution and bounding rows in docs/01-plan/features/doc-block-exec.impl-plan.md, paragraph Mutation rows added here. D6 removes the preamble pass-through row; D7 adds the isolated timeout upper-bound row.

mutations.name: strict-flags-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Always launch plain bash, dropping all strict flags.

mutations.name: preamble-separator-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Concatenate preamble and body without a separator.

mutations.name: cwd-not-passed
mutations._mechanism: Omit the private cwd from Popen.

mutations.name: chmod-0700-removed
mutations._mechanism: Remove explicit permission restoration after mkdtemp.

mutations.name: cleanup-errors-ignored
mutations._mechanism: The injected rmtree honours ignore_errors, losing the recorded OSError.

mutations.name: cleanup-readback-removed
mutations._mechanism: Remove only the post-removal existence check.

mutations.name: precedence-timeout-raised-in-handler
mutations._mechanism: Raise inside the timeout handler, bypassing final cleanup-precedence selection.

mutations.name: launch-oserror-unwrapped
mutations._mechanism: Remove only spawn OSError mapping; both NUL ValueError paths remain mapped, as required by the Task 3 paragraph.
mutations.find:
except (OSError, ValueError) as err:
                pending = LaunchFailed("spawn", err)
mutations.replace:
except ValueError as err:
                pending = LaunchFailed("spawn", err)

mutations.name: killpg-replaced-by-kill
mutations._mechanism: Kill only the leader instead of its process group.

mutations.name: poll-before-killpg-removed
mutations._mechanism: Omit the pre-kill poll that reaps an already-exited leader.

mutations.name: killpg-esrch-uncaught
mutations._mechanism: Remove the already-gone exception arm; ESRCH reaches the generic reap-error mapping.

mutations.name: wait-unbounded
mutations._mechanism: Remove only the bounded timeout keyword from post-kill wait; the wrapper records its absence.

mutations.name: wait-expiry-unmapped
mutations._mechanism: Remove only wait-expiry mapping, retaining the separate OSError guard.
mutations.find:
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as err:
                                outcome = LaunchFailed("reap", err, pgid=proc.pid)
                                outcome.__context__ = pending
                                pending = outcome

mutations.name: drain-unbounded
mutations._mechanism: Remove the drain timeout; the escapee retains its pipe for the real 300-second sleep, violating the elapsed-time assertion.

mutations.name: timeout-validation-removed
mutations._mechanism: Drop the whole numeric predicate, retaining float conversion.

mutations.name: timeout-upper-bound-removed
mutations._mechanism: Drop only the upper clause. The nonpositive-timeout test must remain green; the unrepresentable bound must fail its BadTimeout refusal assertion.

mutations.name: chmod-failure-unwrapped
mutations._mechanism: Move chmod outside launch-error mapping; its OSError escapes while outer cleanup still runs.
mutations.find:
cwd = tempfile.mkdtemp()
            os.chmod(cwd, 0o700)
        except OSError as err:
            pending = LaunchFailed("mkdtemp", err)

mutations.name: chmod-rollback-unguarded
mutations._mechanism: Attempt rollback directly in the chmod handler, so removal failure escapes before verdict selection.
mutations.find:
cwd = tempfile.mkdtemp()
            os.chmod(cwd, 0o700)
        except OSError as err:
            pending = LaunchFailed("mkdtemp", err)

mutations.name: cleanup-error-ignored-when-tree-gone
mutations._mechanism: Ignore the recorded cleanup error when the directory is absent.

mutations.name: timeout-invocation-planted
mutations._mechanism: Prefix both real bash argv branches with external timeout.

mutations.name: mktemp-invocation-planted
mutations._mechanism: Replace Python mkdtemp with the forbidden external invocation.

mutations.name: collect-oserror-unmapped
mutations._mechanism: Remove only the first communicate OSError mapping.
mutations.find:
except OSError as err:
                    pending = LaunchFailed("collect", err, pgid=proc.pid)

mutations.name: drain-oserror-unmapped
mutations._mechanism: Remove OSError mapping from drain communicate, pipe closes and wait, retaining both TimeoutExpired arms.

mutations.name: poll-oserror-unmapped
mutations._mechanism: Remove only the pre-kill poll OSError mapping.

mutations.name: spawn-valueerror-unmapped
mutations._mechanism: Remove only spawn ValueError mapping; empty-PATH OSError remains mapped.
mutations.find:
except (OSError, ValueError) as err:
                pending = LaunchFailed("spawn", err)
mutations.replace:
except OSError as err:
                pending = LaunchFailed("spawn", err)

mutations.name: cleanup-chain-selection-flipped
mutations._mechanism: Collapse cause selection to pending, losing the cleanup-error cause after a successful run.
